message:
This PR fixes the failing CI in Dependabot PR #2466 by upgrading the `scheduler` package to the highest compatible version.

## Problem

The original Dependabot PR attempted to upgrade `scheduler` from 0.20.2 to 0.26.0, but this caused CI failures due to peer dependency conflicts. Multiple FluentUI components require `scheduler` to be within the range `>=0.19.0 <=0.23.0`, making version 0.26.0 incompatible.

## Solution

- Upgraded `scheduler` from 0.20.2 to 0.23.0 (resolves to 0.23.2)
- This is the highest version compatible with FluentUI peer dependency constraints
- All FluentUI components now use `scheduler@0.23.0` consistently
- Maintains the security/update benefits while ensuring compatibility

## Verification

Verified that the following commands succeed (as per the original issue instructions):
- `npm install` - installs dependencies without peer dependency conflicts
- `npx prettier --check .` - passes CI formatting checks
- `npm run build` - builds successfully

The upgrade accomplishes the same goal as the original Dependabot PR while passing all CI checks.

Fixes #2647.
